cs.t: It's a good start, Etymotic makes some of the most uncomfortable earplugs (the most uncomfortable I've ever worn), they sound fine.. as long as you don't need to lie down or rest your head. The naming isn't great in the competition, but: Alpine, EarGasm, EarPeace, Loops are significantly better.  Recent Alpine reviews suggest a material change - so maybe not them (haven't tried the new ones).  They all come in different editions which is mostly about which frequencies they block/allow through.. loop is trying to push the price boundary (probably avoid, especially their "active" line). All better than basic fluorescent foam earplugs though, easier to use and better sound blocking (the good audio ones allow you to speak/hear voices at close to normal volume in front of a 90dB sound stage)
cs.th: Air Purifiers as White Noise Machines

cs.t: I use Loop silicone earplugs, they’re reusable and washable. Used to use the disposables but got tired of the waste.
cs.th: I let AI build a tool to help me figure out what was waking me up at night

cs.t: When my wife showed me the Loop ad, I told her it's a scam. But now I'm the one using them. Haven't done as much work researching earplugs as some posters above, but like the Loops. For comparison, I have earplugs at work, that feel like someone was raping my ear every time I'm putting them on. So, there's definitely earplugs and earplugs. If you need to use them, might be worth few hours and few bucks spent on testing/research.
